item.title: Starmer says Trump’s Greenland tariff threat 'completely wrong' and a trade war in no one’s interest
item.description: LONDON (AP) — British Prime Minister Keir Starmer said Monday that U.S. President Donald Trump’s threat of tariffs against allies over Greenland is “completely wrong” and a trade war is in no one’s interest.

item.title: Prince Harry's court battle against British tabloids reaches final chapter
item.description: LONDON (AP) — Millions of dollars are on the line as Prince Harry returned to court on Monday for the third and final chapter in his legal quest to tame the British tabloids.

item.title: Nation-building efforts expected to spur Canadian M&A this year: KPMG survey
item.description: TORONTO — Canadian dealmaking activity is expected to pick up this year, driven by nation-building efforts and a stronger business outlook, according to a new survey by KPMG Canada.
